Wiring V2 changes the UX from auto-advance to tap-to-advance — founder UX decision required.

V1 renders the actual published media as a looping <Video>/Optimizedto background + thumbnail (PostSuccessScreen.tsx:111-179, peaks vs photo branch). V2 expects a caller `previewSlot` node for ONLY the front card — container must build the Video/Image media node + a multi-media count badge (V1 shows media.length indicator at :173-178; V2 has no count badge, only an optional online badge).

V1 receives route params { media[], postType, fromProfile } (PostSuccessScreen.tsx:33). V2 needs a freshly-published postId to power onViewPost — NOT currently passed in the PostSuccess route params (src/types/index.ts:725/804). Add postId to route params if onViewPost is wired.
V2 confetti/online-badge are new chrome not in V1; safe to add (DS-fill).

If auto-redirect is kept, V2 PostSuccessView cannot host the setTimeout (it's timer-free by contract) — the host container must own the timer + still render V2 as presentational, but then the CTAs are dead. Decide: auto-redirect (drop V2 CTAs) vs interactive (drop V1 timer).
screens.wiringPlan: Host PostSuccessScreen behind FEATURES.V2_UI early-return (after hooks). Resolve the behavior contract first: RECOMMENDED canonical (Instagram/TikTok) = interactive success with 'View post' + 'Back to feed', drop the 3s auto-reset. Container builds: previewSlot = the V1 conditional Video/OptimizedImage media node; onBackToFeed = the V1 navigation.reset({Tabs, fromProfile?Profile}) logic; onViewPost = navigate to the new post detail (requires postId in route params — add to MainStackParamList PostSuccess params at types/index.ts:725,804). Map i18n from existing v2PostSuccessView namespace (config.ts already registers it). Keep V1 analytics 'post published'. If founder prefers auto-redirect, keep V1 unchanged and DEFER V2 (component stays gallery-only).
screens.safeAreaPlan: PostSuccessView uses a ScrollView with paddingTop:56/paddingBottom:40 and no SafeArea. V1 host is full-bleed (full-screen media, no SafeAreaView). For V2 adoption wrap in SafeAreaView edges=['top','bottom'] OR pass host insets into the scroll content padding so the check hero clears the notch and the bottom CTA clears the home indicator.

feGaps: NEW CTAs not in V1: Itinéraire (directions) + Share (header ↗). V1 SpotDetailScreen has neither. Directions needs a maps deep-link helper (V1 imports formatDistance/formatDuration from mapbox-directions but does NOT build a directions intent). Either wire a new directions deep-link or hide the directions CTA (onDirections undefined) for V1 parity.

V1 review rows are NON-tappable (SpotDetailScreen.tsx:314-335). V2 onOpenReviewer makes them tappable to a reviewer profile — net-new affordance; reviewer object has no user_id surfaced in V1 SpotReview shape (only user.full_name/avatar). Need reviewer id from API to wire, else leave onOpenReviewer undefined.

Map hero: V2 takes a single caller mapSlot node (caller bakes marker+route line). V1 builds MapView+Camera+MarkerView+ShapeSource+LineLayer inline (SpotDetailScreen.tsx:20). Container must assemble the mapbox node and pass it as mapSlot — non-trivial (route geojson → LineLayer).

canReview gating: V1 = isVerified || PRO_CREATOR || PRO_BUSINESS (SpotDetailScreen.tsx:90). Container must pass that exact computed boolean to V2 canReview (per-account-type verification, project_branch_migration_nouss_ui3_jun22 rule).

Pre-formatting: V2 expects routeDistanceText/routeDurationText/ratingSummaryText pre-formatted; V1 has routeDistanceKm/routeDurationMin/rating_average/rating_count raw — container formats via formatDistance/formatDuration + a rating-summary string.
Difficulty: V1 DIFFICULTY_COLORS (easy=teal/medium=gold/hard=red/expert=purple) are GRAPHICS; V2 re-expresses as AA-safe per-mode constants (good) — map V1 difficulty string 1:1.

Reviews are UNBOUNDED FlatList in V2 with onRefresh/onEndReached; V1 loads a fixed 20 and renders inline in a ScrollView (no pagination). Container should add cursor pagination or pass onEndReached=undefined.
